_doc: Local snapshot of Agnes AI official model availability. Used by check_official_docs.py as the diff baseline. The /v1/models endpoint is authoritative; per-model doc pages under doc_base_* are a secondary signal (slug = model_id without dots, .md suffix). The full doc index is at llms_txt. Update this when official docs change.

free_tier._doc: Verified 2026-09-21 against official pricing page. 'limited' means promotional free period, may end without notice.
free_tier.notes: agnes-2.0-flash still served (not on the current promo list, live-tested working). agnes-video-2.5 bills per second (720P $0.025/s). Video 2.5/2.5-flash use a NEW parameter schema (mode required: text/keyframe/reference; seconds '4'-'12'; size 720P/1080P/1K/2K; aspect_ratio; first_frame/last_frame/images; width/height/fps/num_frames forbidden) — incompatible with the v2.0 schema this skill sends.

_slug_rule: Per-model doc URL = doc_base_<lang> + '/' + model_id.replace('.', '') + '.md'. e.g. agnes-image-2.5-flash -> https://wiki.agnes-ai.com/en/docs/agnes-image-25-flash.md. Exception: agnes-2.0-flash has no doc page on the new wiki (older model, superseded by 2.5-flash); doc check reports WARNING for it, which is expected.
